items.q: he was playing more guitar than Mango -- Elliot, excuse me.

ctx.x: Where was he from? Do you know where he was from?
I don't know. Charlie died. Then you had a, well, Bill Coleman was there and myself and there was another boy named Oscar. Oscar Edmund. He was from the Argentine..
Now, he was playing more guitar than Mango -- Elliot, excuse me. Yes, he could play more guitar.
